item.text: The mail `Element` union includes Message, Conversation, and encrypted search messages, while the current TypeScript interfaces don’t declare `IsProton`. I’ll keep the helper typed to `Element` and check `IsProton === 1`, which gives identical behavior across the union and safely returns false when absent.

The helper now uses strict equality with `1`, so `0`, missing values, and other values return false. I’m adding focused cases for both Message and Conversation, then I’ll run the existing helper test file.
The focused existing test suite passes, including the new true/false checks for both object types. I’m updating the checkpoint with the result and reviewing the final diff.

Added `isFromProton` in [elements.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/helpers/elements.ts). It returns `true` only when `IsProton === 1`, for both Message and Conversation elements.
